summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 4-wave plan qualifying the verification-tier tie-break (plan-format.md:271) across all four named planning surfaces, introducing a required conditional **Tier Justification** field on every non-final phase and settling the previously-undefined meaning of "the final phase". Planning established one finding research did not have: suite_selection_select returns the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel for three of the four target files, so a cheap tier on a docs edit must cite a gate subset (--only-gate 3,4), not a suite subset. The plan is its own acceptance demonstration: Phases 1-5 declare tiers below full with stated justifications, Phase 6 is the final phase and runs the complete gate set. validate-artifact.sh passes with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 4-wave implementation plan for cost-aware verification-tier selection across plan-format.md, planner-agent.md, task-breakdown.md and phase-closure.md, plus one incidental stale-label fix in plan-format-enforcement.md.
